$comment: Reviewed provider endpoint allowlist for the G5-A pilot connector.
This file is the single source of truth for three runtime values, which
2. the connector's extra_hosts pins (every admitted host -> gateway.address)
Hosts listed under `pending` are NOT admitted and must not appear in any
runtime configuration. Adding a host means moving it into `admitted` with
evidence, then re-running the checker. `chat.zalo.me` is admitted as a
`redirect-target`: it is reachable only as the single validated Location of
the exact checkSession request (adapters/zalo/redirect-policy.ts), never as
a direct request target, and only for the bootstrap stage.
Every hostname here is derived from the shipped zca-js@2.2.0 artifacts.
Nothing was guessed and no hostname was observed from live traffic; see

gateway.$comment: The subnet sits inside RFC1918 172.16.0.0/12 but below Docker's default address pool (172.17.0.0/16 through 172.31.0.0/16), so it cannot be auto-assigned to an unrelated project's network. The address is private, which is what the connector's PILOT_EGRESS_GATEWAY pin requires.

admitted.evidence: zca-js@2.2.0 dist/apis/login.js:6 (/api/login/getLoginInfo) and login.js:25 (/api/login/getServerInfo); both are awaited by zalo.js loginCookie() before an API object is returned
zca-js@2.2.0 dist/apis/loginQR.js:215 (/jr/userinfo), reached from qr-bootstrap.ts loginQR()

redirect.rule: absolute https only; exact host; port empty or 443; no userinfo, IP literal, trailing dot or backslash; never a direct request target; enforced in adapters/zalo/redirect-policy.ts before the socket

admitted.evidence: zca-js@2.2.0 dist/apis/loginQR.js:194-211 requests /account/checksession with continue=https://chat.zalo.me/index.html and dist/utils.js:289-298 follows any Location it receives. The 2026-11-04 attempt is consistent with that redirect but the provider's 302 was not observed, so the admission is conditional on the live observation documented in docs/evidence/G5A-SDK-REDIRECT-ANALYSIS.md

pending.reason: The base URLs for every post-login API come from loginInfo.zpw_service_map_v3 in the provider's login response (zca-js@2.2.0 dist/zalo.js:72). The hostnames exist only at runtime and are provider-controlled, so they cannot be reconstructed from reviewed artifacts.
pending.evidence: dist/apis/sendMessage.js:60,63 use chat[0] and group[0]; 68,69 use file[0]. The connector's SDK surface is getCookie, getOwnId, listener, login, loginQR and sendMessage only

pending.reason: The listener connects to zpw_ws[] from the login response. zca-js@2.2.0 dist/zalo.js:72 passes loginInfo.zpw_ws into new API(...), dist/apis.js:160 builds new Listener(ctx, wsUrls), and dist/apis/listen.js:27 uses urls[0] as the first wsURL and 84-96 rotates through the array on provider close codes. No WebSocket hostname appears anywhere in the reviewed artifacts.

zca-js@2.2.0 dist/utils.js:289-298 follows any Location response header with request(ctx, redirectURL, ...). A provider redirect can therefore name a host that is not in this file. The gateway allowlist and the connector's internal-network topology both refuse it: an unpinned name has no route and no external resolver. Redirect targets must be admitted here before they can be followed. chat.zalo.me is the only target admitted so far (above); every other target stays in this class and is refused by adapters/zalo/redirect-policy.ts as well as by the network boundary.

excluded.reason: Appears only as a `continue` query parameter value in dist/apis/loginQR.js:42,68,93 and as a cookie-domain comparison in dist/utils.js. Never a request target.

dist/update.js:4 NPM_REGISTRY, called from dist/zalo.js:51 checkUpdate(ctx), which returns immediately when ctx.options.checkUpdate is falsy. adapters/zalo/sdk-facade.ts sets checkUpdate:false, so no request is made. Not admitted; if it were ever reached, the gateway would refuse it.
